improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and entry point (3 free searches, pricing from US$2/day). Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. These tags establish credibility and drive qualified traffic without any site code changes beyond the head section.

improvements.suggestion:
Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner

Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try 3 free searches, no card required.
improvements.rationale: This headline positions Gideon as a trusted partner rather than just a tool, appealing to business owners who want reliability. The subheading immediately communicates the three core benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) and removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no payment commitment upfront.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for serious business and trade professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. By clearly explaining what happens next and reinforcing the low entry price and value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and builds confidence to convert.
